properties.title: C# Async/Await State Machines & ThreadPool Starvation
properties.prompt: How does the C# compiler transform an async method into a state machine? What causes ThreadPool starvation when developers call .Result or .Wait() on uncompleted tasks in ASP.NET Core, and how do you resolve it?

properties.rubricGuide: Master/worker architecture, dynamic vs ondemand process managers, OpCache compiling PHP script AST into shared memory opcode, eliminating cold boot overhead, and shared-nothing preventing in-memory state leakage across requests.
hints: What happens when all PHP-FPM workers are busy executing long-running database queries?
How do modern runtimes like Swoole or RoadRunner persist memory?
properties.title: PHP-FPM Worker Scaling & OpCache In-Memory Bytecode
properties.prompt: How does the PHP-FPM execution model handle concurrent web requests under heavy traffic? How does OpCache eliminate compilation overhead, and what are the trade-offs of PHP's shared-nothing architecture compared to persistent application servers?

properties.rubricGuide: Hash-based sharding on tenant_id or user_id, virtual shards on consistent hash ring for painless rebalancing, denormalizing data to eliminate cross-shard joins, and two-phase commit or saga pattern for cross-shard writes.
hints: Why does auto-increment primary key fail as a shard key?
How do virtual shards prevent moving 100% of rows during node additions?
properties.title: Horizontal Database Sharding & Resharding Strategies
properties.prompt: Your single PostgreSQL database is bottlenecked on write throughput. How do you design horizontal sharding across 16 database nodes? What shard key do you choose, and how do you handle cross-shard joins and rebalancing?

properties.rubricGuide: Candidate must articulate 3 circuit states (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF-OPEN), error rate and timeout thresholds, bulkhead thread pool isolation, and fallback responses.
hints: What triggers the transition from OPEN to HALF-OPEN?
How does bulkhead isolation protect thread pools of unrelated endpoints?
properties.title: Microservice Resiliency, Circuit Breakers & Cascading Failure Prevention
properties.prompt: In a microservice mesh, a downstream inventory service begins timing out under heavy traffic, causing upstream API gateways to exhaust their connection pools. How do you design a Circuit Breaker pattern with bulkhead isolation to prevent cascading cluster failure?

properties.rubricGuide: Sequential append-only commit log, zero-copy OS sendfile(), partition consumer offsets, transactional coordinator, and idempotent producer PIDs.
hints: How does Kafka achieve high disk throughput without random I/O?
Sequential disk writes match memory speeds.
properties.title: Distributed Event Streaming & Exactly-Once Semantics in Kafka
properties.prompt: How does Apache Kafka guarantee high write throughput and message ordering within a partition? How do producer idempotent sequence numbers and transactional coordinators achieve exactly-once processing (EOS) in stream pipelines?

properties.rubricGuide: Must use a Doubly Linked List for O(1) node relocation and a Hash Map storing node pointers. Edge cases: empty cache, capacity of 1, duplicate keys.
hints: Use dummy head and tail sentinel nodes to eliminate null checks.
properties.title: LRU Cache Design (O(1) Get & Put)
properties.prompt: Implement a Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache that operates with strictly O(1) time complexity for both get() and put() operations without using language built-in LinkedHashMap.
